## Hello, I'm Jessica!

I am a Professor of Statistics and Director of the
[Titan Supercomputing Center](https://tsc.fullerton.edu/)
at California State University, Fullerton.
As a first-generation college graduate and proud CSUF
alumna, I earned my Ph.D. in Statistics from UCLA.

My work focuses on building programs and partnerships
that expand access to data science education, strengthen
interdisciplinary research, and connect academic learning
with real-world opportunities.

I am particularly passionate about bringing together
students, faculty, academic institutions, and industry
partners to create innovative educational pathways,
meaningful research experiences, and opportunities
for student success.

With a background in statistical methodology and
experimental design, I bring a collaborative,
interdisciplinary perspective to educational innovation
and workforce development.

:::
